element.name: Balat-Kayo
element.description: Made in the image of Haliya's tusked mask, balat-kayo are proud, dutiful, and passionate people. They possess a tracing of starlight across their body, and their eyes are a splendid silver.

element.name: Ability Score Increase (Balat-Kayo)
element.description: Your Charisma score increases by 2, and either your Strength or your Dexterity score increases by 1.

element.name: Darkvision (Balat-Kayo)
element.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

element.name: Relentless Endurance (Balat-Kayo)
element.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

element.name: Weapon Training (Balat-Kayo)
element.description: You gain proficiency with simple and martial weapons.

element.name: Blessing of Haliya
element.description: You know the alarm, detect poison and disease, and identify spells. You can cast each of these spells once as a ritual, and regain the ability to do so after a long rest. When you reach 3rd level, you learn one other spell of 2nd level or lower with the ritual tag. When you reach 5th level, you learn another spell of 3rd level or lower with the ritual tag. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this feature.

element.name: Languages (Balat-Kayo)
element.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Sylvan.

element.name: Umalagad Dragonborn
element.description: Umalagad dragonborn live a second life—having already lived a life, and now back from the dead. They are commonly albino and take on aspects of pythons and crocodiles.

element.name: Ability Score Increase (Umalagad)
element.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

element.name: Blindsight (Umalagad)
element.description: You have blindsight out to 30 feet. You can perceive surroundings within this radius without relying on visual sight.

element.name: Ancestral Protection
element.description: You know the guidance cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the sanctuary spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the warding bond spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

element.name: Languages (Umalagad)
element.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice.

element.name: Volcano Dwarf
element.description: Named for the magma formations that they can produce on their skin and their ash-like trailing hair. Whether they were blessed by volcanic spirits or are themselves spirits of lava brought into a new form is unknown.

element.name: Ability Score Increase (Volcano Dwarf)
element.description: Your Intelligence score increases by 1.

element.name: Molten Armor
element.description: As a bonus action, you can cover your form with a protective shield of hardened lava. You gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your character level, and whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, the creature takes fire damage equal to your character level. The temporary hit points last for 1 hour. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

element.name: Balete Elf
element.description: A balete elf typically has plant roots—akin to that of a balete tree—growing throughout their hair.

element.name: Ability Score Increase (Balete Elf)
element.description: Your Wisdom score increases by 1.

element.name: Verdant Intuition
element.description: When you make an Intelligence (Nature) or Wisdom (Survival) check, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

element.name: Spirit of Nature
element.description: You know the druidcraft cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the entangle spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the barkskin spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

element.name: Gold Gnome
element.description: Gold gnomes are born with natural tattoo-like patterns sprawling across their skin, which take on the lustrous hue of their namesake.

element.name: Ability Score Increase (Gold Gnome)
element.description: Your Charisma score increases by 1.

element.name: Keen Eyes
element.description: You gain proficiency in the Perception skill.

element.name: Gilded Gifts
element.description: During a long rest, you can utilize your innate connection with gold to gild an item and imbue it with magical benefits. These benefits last for 24 hours, or until you take another long rest. Choose one option: Gilded Armor (next creature to don gains temp HP equal to 5 + Cha mod); Gilded Tools (creature using tools can use your proficiency bonus + Cha mod in place of normal modifier); Gilded Weapon (counts as magical, first successful attack is an automatic critical hit).

element.name: Mangrove Halfling
element.description: Patterns reminiscent of the mangrove tree decorate the mangrove halfling.

element.name: Ability Score Increase (Mangrove Halfling)
element.description: Your Intelligence score increases by 1.

element.name: Natural Craftsmanship
element.description: You know the mending cantrip.

element.name: Quick Thinker
element.description: You can take the Help action as a bonus action on your turn.

element.name: Carabao Tiefling
element.description: Tieflings with the horns of carabao command great physical prowess. Strong and resilient, their closeness to nature is reflected by their horns and physique, representing the water buffalo's relentless might.

element.name: Ability Score Increase (Carabao Tiefling)
element.description: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Constitution score increases by 1.

element.name: Immovable
element.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone, pushed, grappled, or restrained.

element.name: Legacy of Might
element.description: You gain proficiency in the Athletics skill. Additionally, when you make a successful melee weapon attack, you can choose to deal the attack's maximum possible damage instead of rolling the damage dice. You can do this a number of times equal to your Strength modifier (minimum once), and regain all uses after a long rest.

element.name: Languages (Carabao Tiefling)
element.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language of your choice.

element.name: Babaylan
element.description: Babaylan are mediums, channeling the power and wisdom of the spirits through offerings and communion. Accompanied by a patron spirit companion known as an abayan, babaylan serve as leaders, protectors, and healers for their communities.

setters.set: Simple Weapons, Coral-Tipped Spears, Kampilans, Songils
Choose two from Arcana, History, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Persuasion, and Religion

element.name: Spellcasting (Babaylan)
element.description: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your babaylan spells. You prepare a number of spells equal to your Intelligence modifier + your babaylan level (minimum one). Cantrips: 3 at 1st level (see table). Spell save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Int modifier. Spell attack modifier = proficiency bonus + Int modifier. You can cast babaylan spells as rituals if they have the ritual tag and you have them prepared.

element.name: Abayan
element.description: Your journey is guided by a steadfast spirit companion known as an abayan. It manifests as an incorporeal semi-transparent creature of Medium size with truesight 60 ft., immune to all damage, and cannot be dismissed or dispelled. You can use it as a spellcasting focus. As a bonus action, you can direct it to move up to 30 ft. It can deliver touch spells and originate area spells.

element.name: Babaylan Calling
element.description: Choose a Babaylan Calling: Call of Clairvoyance, Call of Sacrifice, or Call of Wrath. Your choice grants features at 1st, 2nd, 6th, 11th, and 15th levels.

element.name: Spirit Conduit
element.description: Your abayan lends you a pool of d4s called Spirit Dice (4d4 at 3rd level, increasing with level). You can expend dice to bolster spells: Persistence (increase spell save DC), Precision (add to spell attack roll), or Vehemence (add to spell damage). Total dice expended per turn ≤ Int modifier (minimum 1). Regain all after a long rest.

element.name: Ability Score Improvement (Babaylan)
element.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

element.name: Spirit Recovery
element.description: During a short rest, regain Spirit Dice up to half your Intelligence modifier (rounded up, minimum 1). You also gain resistance to necrotic damage.

element.name: Preternatural Speaker
element.description: You can speak and read all languages, and any creature that can understand a language can understand what you say.

element.name: Walker Between Worlds
element.description: You are immune to necrotic damage and have advantage on death saving throws.

element.name: Mythic Reverence
element.description: Whenever you start your turn with fewer than half your hit point maximum and are not incapacitated, you automatically regain 20 hit points. Additionally, if you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead (three uses, regained after a long rest).

element.name: Call of Clairvoyance
element.description: Babaylan who heed the Call of Clairvoyance specialize in divination and history, opening their bodies as vessels for spirits to pour forth guidance, knowledge, and memories.

element.name: Divining Eye
element.description: You learn the true strike cantrip, which doesn't count against your cantrips known. You can cast it as a bonus action, and you cannot lose concentration on it as a result of taking damage.

element.name: Vessel for the Spirits
element.description: As an action, your abayan enters your body for 10 minutes (or until you use an action to expel it). You gain advantage on Intelligence checks to recall knowledge, add Int modifier to concentration saves, and can cast detect evil and good, detect poison and disease, and identify once each without expending spell slots. Once used, cannot use again until a short or long rest.

element.name: Clarity of Mind
element.description: You are immune to being charmed or frightened.

element.name: Piercing Sight
element.description: You gain truesight out to 30 feet when using Vessel for the Spirits.

element.name: Living Memory
element.description: Touch an object or creature to commune with its spirit and glimpse significant events from its past (Int check if hostile, DC 15+; automatic if friendly). Number of events = Int modifier (minimum 1). Once used, cannot use again until a short or long rest.

element.name: Call of Sacrifice
element.description: Experts in healing and herbalism, babaylan following the Call of Sacrifice dedicate themselves to remedying the hurts that plague their communities.

element.name: Undanted Healer
element.description: Whenever your abayan is within 30 feet of you and you cast a spell to restore hit points, add your proficiency bonus to the hit points regained by each creature.

element.name: Absolve Hurt
element.description: Friendly creatures within 10 ft. of your abayan gain +2 bonus to saving throws against damaging spells/effects. When a creature within 30 ft. of your abayan takes damage, you can use your reaction to expend a spell slot and reduce the damage by your babaylan level + 1d6 per slot level.

element.name: Yield Vitality
element.description: As an action, choose a spellcaster within 30 ft. of your abayan. Lose hit points equal to 10 × the recovered spell slot's level; the creature recovers one expended spell slot of your choice. If this reduces you to 0 HP by an amount ≥ your HP maximum, you die instantly.

element.name: Hale of Body
element.description: You are immune to all poison and disease.

element.name: Banish Affliction
element.description: As an action, end one condition on yourself or a willing creature you touch: blinded, charmed, cursed, deafened, frightened, petrified, paralyzed, or poisoned. Uses = Int modifier (minimum 1), regained after a long rest.

element.name: Call of Wrath
element.description: Babaylan who heed the Call of Wrath wield menacing martial prowess alongside powerful sorcery, becoming fearsome warriors.

element.name: Bonus Proficiencies (Call of Wrath)
element.description: You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons.

element.name: Guided Strikes
element.description: Whenever you are within 10 ft. of your abayan, you can use your Intelligence modifier for weapon attack and damage rolls instead of Strength or Dexterity. At 6th level, range increases to 30 ft. At 15th level, works regardless of distance.

element.name: Fury of the Spirits
element.description: When you take the Attack action, your abayan can make one melee spell attack (+ your spell attack modifier) against a hostile creature within 5 ft. of it. Hit: 2d6 force damage (3d6 at 5th, 4d6 at 11th, 6d6 at 17th).

element.name: Magic Warrior
element.description: Your weapon attacks count as magical. When you use Spirit Conduit, you can apply Precision and Vehemence to weapon attacks and damage.

element.name: Tempered Will
element.description: You can no longer lose concentration on a spell as a result of taking damage.

element.name: Armor of Ancients
element.description: As an action, call upon warrior babaylan spirits for 1 minute. You are immune to nonmagical bludgeoning/piercing/slashing, gain resistance to all other damage types, gain temp HP equal to Int mod + proficiency bonus + babaylan level, and creatures that hit you with melee attacks take force damage equal to 1d6 + your babaylan level. Once used, cannot use again until a short or long rest.

element.name: Headhunter
element.description: Headhunters are trained to commune with the spirits of their ancestors, and it is via this connection that they hone their martial skill. Through rites and omens, they receive knowledge of those to pursue; from those they send to the afterlife, they learn ways to hone their tools of combat.

setters.set: Choose two from Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, Religion, and Survival

element.name: Focused Hunter
element.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

element.name: Conviction
element.description: Once per round, when you target a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal 1d4 force damage to it (this doesn't require the attack to hit; on a critical hit, the force damage is multiplied). The damage increases as you gain levels (see Headhunter table).

element.name: Rite of the Ancestors
element.description: When you finish a long rest, choose one creature as your quarry (you need only know enough about it to describe it). Ask three of: What is my quarry's AC? Is it within 1 mile? What is one damage resistance? What is one damage vulnerability? What is its highest ability score? You cannot choose another quarry until another long rest.

element.name: Fighting Style (Headhunter)
element.description: Choose a Fighting Style: Defense, Distance, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection, Pursuant, or Skirmisher. (See class description for details.)

element.name: Hunter's Omen
element.description: Choose a Hunter's Omen: Omen of Knowledge, Omen of Strife, or Omen of Swiftness. Your choice grants features at 3rd, 7th, 14th, and 18th levels.

element.name: Ability Score Improvement (Headhunter)
element.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. Maximum 20.

element.name: Forgiveness for the Slain
element.description: Approach a corpse of a creature that died within the last 24 hours (must be recognizable, not undead). Over 10 minutes, ask the spirit up to two questions (answers may be brief/cryptic; the spirit may lie if hostile). Once used, cannot use again until a long rest.

element.name: Unwavering Hunter
element.description: You are immune to being charmed and frightened. Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

element.name: Tireless Pursuit
element.description: You can no longer receive levels of exhaustion from a forced march.

element.name: Dread Presence
element.description: Your movement no longer provokes attacks of opportunity.

element.name: Inevitable
element.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18–20.

element.name: Omen of Knowledge
element.description: Headhunters beset with an Omen of Knowledge carry the weight of what they've done with them every step of the way. These headhunters carry the memories of the dead with them always, learning from their errors and offering absolution.

element.name: Lessons of the Departed
element.description: When you finish a long rest, gain proficiency in saving throws with one ability of your choice and one skill or tool proficiency. These last until your next long rest.

element.name: Memories of War
element.description: Choose two Memory options from the list (Assured Mark, Cloaked Terror, Cycle Breaker, Guardian, Living Shield, Nimble Warrior, Pinning Strike, Silent One, Rending Blow, Unerring Eye, Waning Might). Gain an additional Memory at 7th, 10th, 14th, and 18th level.

element.name: Study Remembrance
element.description: When you finish a short or long rest, choose one damage type. You gain resistance to that damage type until you use this feature again.

element.name: Inescapable End
element.description: If you roll initiative and have fewer than half your hit points, you can regain hit points equal to 10 × your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). Once used, cannot use again until a long rest.

element.name: Memoriam
element.description: Whenever you finish a long rest, you can replace one Memory option with another option of your choice.

element.name: Omen of Strife
element.description: Headhunters carrying an Omen of Strife are some of the most formidable forces in combat, embracing the violence of their profession with grim and fearsome skill.

element.name: Bonus Proficiencies (Omen of Strife)
element.description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor and the Intimidation skill.

element.name: A Westriking Presence
element.description: As a bonus action, choose one creature within 30 ft. that can see you. It must make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency + Cha mod). On a failure, its speed is reduced by 10 ft. and you have advantage on weapon attacks against it until the start of your next turn; also advantage on Intimidation checks against it for 10 minutes. Uses = Cha modifier (minimum 1), regained after a long rest.

element.name: Formidable Conviction
element.description: When you use Conviction, add an additional 1d8 to the force damage.

element.name: The Cost of Fear
element.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal a cumulative −1 penalty to its AC. This penalty fades after 1 hour. Uses = Cha modifier, regained after a short or long rest.

element.name: Retribution
element.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal extra damage equal to the number of hit points you are currently missing. Once used, cannot use again until a short or long rest.

element.name: Omen of Swiftness
element.description: Headhunters bestowed with an Omen of Swiftness find themselves pulled towards Amanikabli, the god of the swift hunt. Through worship and offering, these headhunters learn to become channels for Amanikabli's power, using divine magic to aid their journey across the islands.

element.name: Spellcasting (Omen of Swiftness)
element.description: You learn two cantrips from the cleric spell list (a third at 10th level). Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. You know three 1st-level cleric spells of your choice. The Omen of Swiftness Spellcasting table shows spell slots and spells known. Spell save DC = 8 + proficiency + Wis mod; spell attack modifier = proficiency + Wis mod.

element.name: Devoted Soul
element.description: When you use Conviction, you gain temporary hit points equal to half the force damage rolled (rounded down, minimum 1).

element.name: Blessed Warrior
element.description: Your weapon attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances and immunities.

element.name: Grim Persistence
element.description: As a bonus action, teleport to an unoccupied space within 30 ft. of your quarry (you must be able to see the quarry). Then make one weapon attack against the quarry with advantage. Once used, cannot use again until a long rest.

element.name: Many-Limbed Silhouette
element.description: When you score a critical hit with a spell attack, you can use your bonus action to make two weapon attacks with advantage.

element.name: Path of the Black River
element.description: The power of the Black River courses through you, and as it calls out for those who deny it, your blood courses with its power.

element.name: Isolation of the Soul
element.description: When you hit a creature while raging, force a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Wis mod + proficiency). Undead automatically fail. On a failure, the creature loses sight of anything beyond 30 ft. (including tremorsense/blindsight). You regain hit points equal to proficiency bonus on successful attacks against it. Only one creature affected at a time. Uses = Str modifier; recover one after a short rest, all after a long rest.

element.name: Treading Rampage
element.description: As a reaction to being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, or poisoned, lose 1d6 + proficiency bonus HP to end the condition. At 10th level, as a reaction to being petrified or stunned, lose 2d6 + proficiency bonus HP to end the condition.

element.name: Living Tide
element.description: As an action, cast dimension door. You can bring additional willing creatures by losing HP equal to your Str modifier per additional creature. Regain use after a long rest.

element.name: Burial Shroud
element.description: While raging, you assume a spectral appearance: movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks; you can move through creatures/objects as difficult terrain (ending inside a creature deals 4d6 psychic damage and forces it out); the first creature you hit each turn with a melee weapon attack must make a Constitution save (DC 8 + proficiency + Wis mod) or have its HP maximum reduced by 1d6 + half your barbarian level (if reduced to 0, can't be resurrected except via wish).

element.name: College of Siday
element.description: Bards of the College of Siday serve as keepers of history, performing epic poems that require the dedication of both body and soul.

element.name: Noble Fortitude
element.description: Levels of exhaustion never impose disadvantage on your ability checks, attack rolls, or saving throws. When you use Song of Rest, affected creatures add your Charisma modifier to the extra hit points regained.

element.name: Folkloric Epics
element.description: As a bonus action, expend one Bardic Inspiration to begin a Folkloric Epic for 1 minute (or until ended as a bonus action). While performing, you cannot cast concentration spells. Options: Poem of the Ancients (you and allies within 15 ft. add Cha mod to attack rolls); Tale of the Warriors (once per turn, you and allies within 15 ft. add force damage equal to your bard level on a hit); Visage of the Sun (you and allies within 15 ft. gain +1 AC; hostile melee attackers must make a Con save vs your spell DC or be blinded until the start of their next turn).

element.name: Bolstering Verse
element.description: While performing a Folkloric Epic, you and friendly creatures within 15 ft. have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. You can cast enhance ability without expending a spell slot or material components (uses = Cha modifier, regained after a long rest).

element.name: The Footsteps of Heroes
element.description: While performing a Folkloric Epic: you are resistant to all damage; you have advantage on Dexterity saving throws; once per turn, when an ally affected by the Epic misses with a weapon attack, you can cause it to hit instead.

element.name: Volcano Domain
element.description: Clerics of the volcano domain channel the raw force that the volcano commands in either destruction or growth.

element.name: Domain Spells (Volcano)
element.description: 1st: create or harden lava, purify food and drink. 3rd: lesser restoration, molten shell. 5th: beacon of hope, eruption. 7th: control lava, fire shield. 9th: greater restoration, volcanic wall. These are always prepared and don't count against your prepared spells.

element.name: Volcanic Calling
element.description: You learn the light and mending cantrips. You gain proficiency in one of: Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

element.name: Channel Divinity: Pyroclasm
element.description: As an action, present your holy symbol and summon an eruption. Each hostile creature within 15 ft. makes a Dexterity save vs your spell DC, taking 3d6 + cleric level fire damage on a failure (half on success). Each friendly creature within 15 ft. then regains hit points equal to your cleric level.

element.name: Revitalize and Renew
element.description: When you score a critical hit, choose one creature within 30 ft. that you can see; it regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt by the critical hit.

element.name: Divine Strike (Volcano)
element.description: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 fire damage (2d8 at 14th level).

element.name: Igneous Scion
element.description: As an action, activate a 30 ft. aura for 1 minute (or until incapacitated). Hostile creatures starting their turn in the aura must make a Con save or be stunned until the start of their next turn. You and friendly creatures in the aura gain +2 AC. You immediately cast beacon of hope without expending a slot (no concentration required; lasts for the aura's duration). Once used, cannot use again until a long rest.

element.name: Circle of Tides
element.description: Druids of the Circle of Tides understand that nature is not something to be tamed or controlled, but rather something to work alongside—nothing exemplifies this more than the sea itself.

element.name: Quiet Undercurrent
element.description: As an action, commune with the world for 1 hour. You cannot be surprised while conscious, difficult terrain doesn't reduce your or allies' movement, and you and allies within 15 ft. gain a bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1). Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder; you have resistance to that damage type until the effect ends. Ends early if incapacitated.

element.name: Adaptation
element.description: As an action, expend a use of Wild Shape to adopt an adaptation (lasting 1 minute or until another Wild Shape is used; only one at a time): Alacrity (Dodge as bonus action); Balm (chosen creature automatically gets one successful death save the first time it drops to 0); Earthquake (tremorsense 60 ft.); Shell (chosen creature gains AC bonus equal to half your Wis modifier, min +1); Tidal Wave (at end of your turn, creatures within 5 ft. make Con save vs your spell DC or take 1d8 + druid level force damage).

element.name: Ebb and Flow
element.description: When you are hit with an attack, use your reaction to take no damage and instead regain hit points equal to half the damage dealt (rounded up). Uses = Wis modifier, regained after a short or long rest.

element.name: Shifting Sands
element.description: After rolling initiative but before the first round, you can swap initiative counts with a hostile creature you can see.

element.name: Increased Adaptation
element.description: When you use Adaptation, you can also choose: Regrowth (end one condition on a chosen creature and grant immunity to it for the duration); Roots (disappear into the earth and emerge within 30 ft., with advantage on your first attack after); Wind (gain a flying speed equal to your movement speed; if already flying, increase by 15 ft.).

element.name: Kawal
element.description: As a kawal, you are more than just a warrior. When destruction threatens your home, you are the first to rise and protect it; when danger targets your allies, you become their shield.

element.name: Steadfast Protector
element.description: You have advantage on all ability checks and saving throws against being grappled, poisoned, pushed, or restrained. Whenever you use Second Wind, you regain the maximum number of hit points possible.

element.name: Guardian Roar
element.description: As a bonus action, choose up to three creatures within 30 ft. that can hear you. Each must make a Wisdom save (DC 8 + proficiency + Con mod). On a failure, for 1 minute the creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you. On a success, the effect lasts until the end of your next turn. Once used, cannot use again until a short or long rest.

element.name: Counter Destruction
element.description: When subjected to damage, use your reaction to make a Constitution save (DC 10 or half the damage, whichever is higher). On a success, take no damage and reflect the full damage back at the attacker. Uses = Con modifier (minimum 1), regained after a short or long rest.

element.name: Resolute Loyalty
element.description: You are immune to being charmed or frightened. You can take up to two reactions per turn instead of one.

element.name: Warrior's Legacy
element.description: When targeted with an attack, use your reaction to call upon ancestral kawals for 1 minute (or until incapacitated): add proficiency bonus to weapon damage; you and allies within 10 ft. gain +1 AC; you and allies within 10 ft. have advantage on Str, Dex, and Con saves. Once used, cannot use again until a long rest.

element.name: Peerless Defense
element.description: You can take up to three reactions per turn instead of one.

element.name: Way of Kaluluwa
element.description: Monks of the Way of Kaluluwa train to split their soul and body apart, having both fight alongside each other.

element.name: Temperament of the Soul
element.description: Your unarmed strikes deal psychic damage instead of bludgeoning damage.

element.name: Schism of Self
element.description: As an action, spend 2 ki points to manifest your soul in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. Your soul is a translucent blue copy using your speed, AC, size, and saving throws, but has no separate HP (damage to it subtracts from your HP). Both act on the same initiative; one uses your action, the other your bonus action (or vice versa); your soul can use your reaction. When both are within 10 ft. of each other, you have advantage on attack rolls and Str/Dex skill checks. Lasts 1 minute or until incapacitated.

element.name: Diversion of Magic
element.description: When you or your soul are targeted by a spell or magical effect, you can use your reaction and spend 1 ki point to reduce the damage by 1d10 (2d10 at 11th level).

element.name: Refinement of Aspects
element.description: While split, use your bonus action and spend 1 ki point to gain one benefit until the start of your next turn: Refinement of the Soul (your soul gains resistance to fire, lightning, cold, thunder, radiant, and necrotic); Refinement of the Body (your physical form gains resistance to piercing, slashing, bludgeoning, poison, acid, force, and psychic).

element.name: Untethered Forms
element.description: At the start of your turn while split, spend 3 ki points to give your physical form and soul each their own separate action, bonus action, and reaction for the round.

element.name: Oath of Blood
element.description: The Oath of Blood demands a sacrifice of self in order to aid another. To the one you swear this oath to, you become the truest extension of their will.

element.name: Oath Spells (Blood)
element.description: 3rd: sanctuary, bless. 5th: revivify, warding bond. 9th: protection from energy, remove curse. 13th: death ward, stoneskin. 17th: dispel evil and good, wall of force.

element.name: Channel Divinity (Oath of Blood)
element.description: My Shield Is For Others: choose an ally; for 1 minute, when a creature within your movement speed targets that ally with an attack, use your reaction to move toward the attacker and make one melee attack. Under My Light: as a bonus action, present your holy symbol and grant an ally temporary HP equal to 2d8 + your paladin level.

element.name: Sanguine Light (10 ft.)
element.description: Whenever an ally within 10 ft. of you takes damage, your next successful attack deals an additional 3 damage. This is cumulative (two allies = +6, three = +9, etc.).

element.name: Resilient Guardian
element.description: As an action, designate an ally for 1 minute. At the end of your turn, if both you and the ally have fewer than half your maximum HP remaining, you both regain HP equal to 2d8 + your paladin level. Once used, cannot use again until a short or long rest.

element.name: Sanguine Light (30 ft.)
element.description: The range of your Sanguine Light aura increases to 30 ft.

element.name: Avatar of Sacrifice
element.description: As a bonus action for 1 minute (or until incapacitated): when asked to make a Dex or Con save to avoid damage, you can make a Charisma save with advantage instead; as a bonus action, lose 10 HP to regain one use of Channel Divinity; spell slots expended for Divine Smite are treated as one level higher. Once used, cannot use again until a long rest.

element.name: Mangangayaw
element.description: Throughout the conflicts you have endured, you have tempered your will to fight with speed and adrenaline. You will always be faster to embrace the fight.

element.name: Innate Speech
element.description: Gain proficiency in one of: Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion. Whenever an ability check would use your Charisma modifier, you can use your Wisdom modifier instead.

element.name: Striker's March
element.description: Whenever a creature targets you with an attack, your movement speed increases by 15 ft. until the end of your next turn. While increased, your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and you can reroll one weapon attack roll.

element.name: Lowering Strikes
element.description: Once per turn when you hit with an attack, you can make it a bleeding strike: target takes an extra 1d4 damage and must use its action to staunch the wound or take another 1d4 at the start of its turn. Uses = Wis modifier (minimum 1), regained after a short or long rest. Damage increases to 2d4 at 11th level and 3d4 at 15th.

element.name: Undertow
element.description: Dragging, pushing, or lifting an object no longer reduces your speed. When subjected to an effect allowing a Dex or Con save for half damage, you can use your reaction to move up to your speed and shield one creature also caught in the effect. You automatically fail the save, but the shielded creature takes no damage.

element.name: Eternal March
element.description: You are permanently under the effect of Striker's March. While wearing Medium Armor, you may add your Wisdom modifier to your AC.

element.name: Graverobber
element.description: Graverobbers are rogues who have imbued themselves with eldritch power via desecrating a grave. This power is typically linked to a trinket stolen from said burial site.

element.name: Cursed Magic
element.description: You learn three cantrips from the warlock spell list (another at 9th level). Charisma is your spellcasting ability. Spell save DC = 10 + proficiency + Cha mod; spell attack modifier = proficiency + Cha mod.

element.name: Anathema
element.description: After using Cunning Action, you can target a creature within 30 ft. (if you haven't used Sneak Attack this turn). It makes a Wisdom save vs your spell DC, taking damage equal to your Sneak Attack on a failure (half on success). Damage type depends on your curse manifestation: Pestilence (poison), Avarice (psychic), or Destruction (force). You can change manifestation when you gain a level.

element.name: Eldritch Secrets
element.description: You learn one additional warlock cantrip. Gain features based on your curse: Pestilence (advantage vs poison, Anathema poison ignores resistance/immunity, cast stinking cloud once per short/long rest without components); Avarice (proficiency in Wisdom saves, cast haste on yourself once per short/long rest); Destruction (resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning/piercing/slashing, cast lightning bolt once per short/long rest without components).

element.name: Afflict Ruin
element.description: As a bonus action, curse a creature within 30 ft. that can hear you for 1 minute (or until incapacitated). You score critical hits on 19–20 against it; it has disadvantage on saves against your Anathema; when you use Anathema against it, you can use your reaction to regain HP equal to half the damage dealt. If it drops to 0 HP, you can transfer the curse to a new creature as a bonus action.

element.name: Shroud of Desecration
element.description: As a bonus action, wrap yourself in a shroud of grave energy for 1 minute (or until incapacitated). You gain a flying speed of 30 ft., can move through creatures/objects as difficult terrain, and have advantage on Stealth checks. Additionally, once per turn when you hit with a Sneak Attack, you can force the target to make a Con save vs your spell DC or be poisoned for 1 minute. Once used, cannot use again until a long rest.

element.name: Diwata Bloodline
element.description: You herald from a nature spirit of great power in the world. Be it the sun, the moon, a volcano, or an ocean, you represent the union of the spirit and the mortal.

element.name: Spirit's Cunning
element.description: You gain proficiency in the Nature skill. You can speak, understand, and write Sylvan. When conversing with a creature that understands Sylvan, you have advantage on Charisma skill checks toward it.

element.name: Sorcerous Nature
element.description: When you learn or replace a sorcerer cantrip or spell of 1st level or higher, you can choose it from the druid spell list or the sorcerer spell list. It becomes a sorcerer spell for you.

element.name: Icon of the Spirit
element.description: As a bonus action, spend 2 sorcery points to summon an Icon of your ancestral nature spirit in an unoccupied space within 30 ft. While within 30 ft. of the Icon, your touch-range spells can target any creature or object within 30 ft. of the Icon. The Icon is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled. On subsequent turns, spend 1 sorcery point to maintain it (free action). It disappears if you are incapacitated.

element.name: Icon's Territory
element.description: While within 30 ft. of your Icon, you can use your movement to teleport to any unoccupied space within 30 ft. of the Icon. This doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

element.name: One with Nature
element.description: When you summon your Icon, you can spend 5 additional sorcery points to imbue yourself: you are immune to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing and can't lose concentration from damage; at the start of your turn, you and allies within 30 ft. of you or your Icon regain HP equal to 1d8 + your Cha modifier; hostile creatures starting their turn within 30 ft. of you or your Icon must make a Wisdom save vs your spell DC or be frightened until the start of their next turn. Lasts until incapacitated or you stop maintaining the Icon.

element.name: Mooneater Patron
element.description: You have made a pact with an entity of hunger—of spite, envy, lust, greed. The Celestial Eaters loom over the islands like gnawing shadows.

element.name: Expanded Spell List (Mooneater)
element.description: 1st: inflict wounds, thunderwave. 2nd: enlarge/reduce, pass without trace. 3rd: call lightning, water walk. 4th: dominate beast, phantasmal killer. 5th: planar binding, telekinesis.

element.name: Celestial Yearning
element.description: You can give yourself a bonus to initiative rolls equal to your Charisma modifier.

element.name: Agent of Destruction
element.description: You have a pool of d6s equal to 1 + your warlock level. Once per turn, when you make a weapon attack or cast a spell requiring an attack roll, you can spend dice from the pool (maximum = Cha modifier, minimum 1) and add the total rolled as force damage. Regain all expended dice after a long rest.

element.name: Devour Essence
element.description: When a creature dies within 60 ft. of you, use your bonus action to absorb its essence for 1 minute: resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing; bonus to attack rolls equal to half your warlock level (rounded up); when you cast a damaging spell requiring a save, add your Cha modifier to the total damage. Once used, cannot use again until a short or long rest.

element.name: Eclipsing Fear
element.description: You are immune to being frightened. When another creature attempts to frighten you, use your reaction to turn the effect back on it: it makes a Charisma save vs your warlock spell DC. On a failure, it takes psychic damage equal to your warlock level and is frightened of you for 1 minute. On a success, half damage and not frightened.

element.name: Cataclysmic Hunger
element.description: You have advantage on initiative rolls. On your first turn of combat, as an action, target a number of creatures that haven't taken a turn yet equal to your Cha modifier. Each must make a Constitution save vs your spell DC, taking 8d8 force damage on a failure (half on success). Once used, cannot use again until a long rest.

element.name: The Crab's Wrath
element.description: Prerequisite: Mooneater patron. As a reaction to rolling initiative, summon ethereal crab armor for 1 minute: AC = 10 + Dex mod + Cha mod (regardless of armor); swimming speed equal to walking speed; after the Attack action, use a bonus action to make a melee spell attack with a spectral claw (2d6 bludgeoning, increasing to 3d6 at 5th, 4d6 at 11th, 5d6 at 17th). Once used, cannot use again until a short or long rest.

element.name: The Eagle's Rapacity
element.description: Prerequisite: Mooneater patron. As an action, sprout spectral wings for 1 minute: flying speed equal to half your movement speed. Immediately and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, force creatures within 5 ft. to make a Dexterity save vs your spell DC, taking 1d8 magical piercing damage on a failure (2d8 at 5th, 3d8 at 11th, 4d8 at 17th). Once used, cannot use again until a long rest.

element.name: The Lion's Revelry
element.description: Prerequisite: Mooneater patron. You gain proficiency in Acrobatics, and you can use your bonus action to take the Dash action. Immediately after, release a roar: each creature in a 15-ft. cone makes a Constitution save vs your spell DC, taking 2d4 thunder damage on a failure (3d4 at 5th, 4d4 at 11th, 6d4 at 17th).

element.name: The Serpent's Ire
element.description: Prerequisite: Mooneater patron. You gain proficiency in Intimidation. As a reaction to rolling initiative, summon a terrifying visage for 1 minute: gain temporary HP equal to your warlock level; once per turn add proficiency bonus to a weapon attack or spell damage; when a creature that can see you starts its turn within 30 ft., use your reaction to force a Wisdom save vs your spell DC—on a failure it takes psychic damage equal to your Cha modifier + warlock level and is frightened until the visage ends (half damage and not frightened on success). Once used, cannot use again until a short or long rest.

element.name: The Spider's Cunning
element.description: Prerequisite: Mooneater patron. You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice. As a bonus action, target a creature within 30 ft.: it must succeed on a Dexterity save vs your spell DC or be restrained by ethereal webs (it can use its action to repeat the save, ending the effect on a success).

element.name: Lorechanter
element.description: You've spent your life learning the tales of your people with a fervent dedication. History is no mere thing to let slip by, but something to be celebrated.

element.name: Living Memory (Lorechanter)
element.description: You gain advantage on all checks to recall histories or legends from or related to your home island.

element.name: Mangangalakal
element.description: You are one well versed in trade and worth, skilled in bartering and the social graces it demands. You are a member of the trade routes that connect one community to another.

element.name: Shrewd Tongue
element.description: You have advantage on all checks made to haggle or discern the true value of a good or service.

element.name: Panday
element.description: You are a crafter of heightened and dedicated skill. Through years of effort and practice you have honed your craft to a fine degree, and are on the road to total mastery.

element.name: Skilled Artisan
element.description: Crafting or repairing something that relates to your specialization requires half the usual cost of materials.

element.name: Sea Raider
element.description: You were raised to traverse the sea and to fight alongside others. You began sailing when others first learn to farm or when others learn of the spirit, and learned the ways of combat at sea.

element.name: Fearsome Sailor
element.description: When you make a successful attack against a boat and roll for damage, you can reroll one damage die. You must use the second roll.

element.name: Voyager
element.description: Your life has known the sea all your life. Where others may visit it and return to land, you are a mere visitor on the ground.

element.name: Uncharted Depths
element.description: You can hold your breath for a minimum of 5 minutes, regardless of your Constitution modifier.

element.name: Aswang Lineage
element.description: You were born into a family afflicted with evil. One member of your family is taboo personified—an aswang. All your life, you have lived with this simple truth: that you are related to that which reflects all the wrong a mortal can do.

element.name: Sinister Visage
element.description: You have advantage on any check made to terrify or unnerve someone.

element.name: Apolaki's Light

setters.set: 1 reaction, which you take in response to being damaged by a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see

element.description: A flare of solar light erupts from your form, lashing toward the creature that damaged you. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 1d12 radiant damage and is blinded until the start of its next turn. On a success, half damage and not blinded. At Higher Levels: +1d12 damage per slot level above 1st.

element.name: Aqueous Affinity
element.description: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to take action underwater with ease. For the duration, the target gains a swimming speed equal to its movement speed, making weapon attacks underwater no longer imposes disadvantage, and while submerged the target has advantage on all Dexterity saving throws.

element.name: Bonded Spirits

setters.set: V, S, M (a small offering of food)

element.description: You touch a willing creature and implore a local nature spirit to bond with them. For the duration, the spirit follows the target (invisible to all but the target), granting +1 bonus to all saving throws and an extra 1d6 damage on weapon attacks. The damage type depends on the spirit (1d6: Lava=Fire, Water=Cold, Wind=Thunder, Rock=Force, Vine=Poison, Storm=Lightning). At Higher Levels: +1d6 extra damage per slot level above 2nd.

element.name: Celestial Chaos
element.description: Celestial storms of moonbeams and solar flares erupt at three points you see within range. Each creature in a 30-ft. radius sphere centered on each point makes a Dexterity save, taking 12d12 radiant damage on a failure (half on success). A creature caught in more than one burst is affected only once. For the duration, creatures entering a storm's area or starting their turn there make a Constitution save, taking 6d12 damage and being blinded until the start of their next turn on a failure (half damage and not blinded on success). Roll 1d20 for damage type: even = fire, odd = cold. You can choose up to eight creatures to be immune.

element.name: Colors of Hanan

setters.set: V, S, M (gold dust mixed with pigments)

element.description: You touch a willing creature and draw a magical tattoo along its back. For the duration, the target can change the tattoo's color as a bonus action, gaining: Gold (+1 AC); Orange (weapon attacks count as magical); Pink (regain 1d4+1 HP at the start of its turn if not incapacitated); Purple (advantage on Dexterity and Constitution saves).

element.name: Commune with Great Spirits

setters.set: V, S, M (betel nut prepared to be shared)

element.description: You call upon a great spirit inhabiting the area within 3 miles. Choose: Ask questions (up to three, answered in one sentence or less; spirits can deceive—make a Wisdom (Insight) check to discern intentions), or Request assistance (the spirit helps with one natural phenomenon or obstacle within its purview; greater requests are riskier and may be twisted).

element.name: Control Lava

setters.set: V, S, M (a piece of pumice stone)

element.description: You control molten lava in a cube up to 100 ft. on a side. Choose an effect (repeatable as an action): Overflow (lava rises up to 10 ft.; creatures entering/starting in it make a Con save, 3d8 fire damage on failure, half on success); Part Lava (create a trench); Redirect Lava Flow (move lava in a direction; creatures entering make a Con save, 3d8 fire damage on failure, half on success; flammables ignite).

element.name: Coral Cage

setters.set: V, S, M (a piece of coral)

element.description: A twisting structure of coral erupts from the ground, enclosing one creature you can see. It makes a Dexterity save: on a failure, 3d8 force damage and restrained; on a success, half damage and not restrained. An aswang automatically fails. A restrained creature can use its action to repeat the save, ending the condition on a success (aswangs do so at disadvantage). At Higher Levels: +1d8 damage per slot level above 3rd.

element.name: Create or Harden Lava

setters.set: V, S, M (a shard of obsidian if creating lava, or a chunk of volcanic rock if hardening it)

element.description: Create Lava: melt up to a 10-ft. cube of stone, packed dirt, or volcanic rock into lava. Creatures entering or starting their turn there make a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 fire damage on a failure (half on success); flammables ignite. Harden Lava: harden a 10-ft. cube of lava into cooled volcanic rock; creatures submerged when cast must make a Con save or be restrained. At Higher Levels: cube size increases by 5 ft. per slot level above 1st.

element.name: Cry of the Spirits

setters.set: V, S, M (a delicate wood carving, or a bowl of food offerings)

element.description: You cry out to the spirits, gathering their power into a whirling 30-ft. sphere centered on a point you can see. Each creature within makes a Dexterity save, taking 12d6 force damage on a failure (half on success). Any creature reduced below a hit point threshold equal to ten times your spellcasting modifier is immediately incapacitated.

element.name: Eruption

setters.set: V, S, M (a piece of igneous rock)
Bard, Cleric, Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard

element.description: A point you choose within range explodes into a spray of molten rocks and lava. Each creature within 30 ft. makes a Dexterity save, taking 4d6 fire damage plus 4d6 thunder damage on a failure (half on success). The area becomes difficult terrain until the end of your next turn. At Higher Levels: +1d6 thunder damage per slot level above 3rd.

element.name: False Self

setters.set: 1 reaction, which you take upon being subjected to the grappled or restrained condition

element.description: You create a false effigy of yourself and swap places with it. You are no longer grappled or restrained and appear in an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of your original location. The effigy remains in your original location and becomes the target of the grapple/restraint. It lasts until the start of your next turn.

element.name: Lava Plume
element.description: You cause a 5-ft. tall fountain of lava to burst from the ground at a point within range. All creatures within 5 ft. of the lava must make a Dexterity save or take 1d6 fire damage. At 5th level (2d6), 11th (3d6), 17th (4d6).

element.name: Lizard Skin

setters.set: V, M (a scale from a reptile)
Bard, Druid, Ranger, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard

element.description: You touch a willing creature and a layer of scales ripples across its skin. For the duration, the target gains 5 temporary hit points and a +1 bonus to AC. As a reaction to being grappled or restrained, the target can shed a layer and slip away: immediately end the condition and move to an unoccupied space 5 ft. away. At Higher Levels: +5 temp HP per slot level above 2nd.

element.name: Mayari's Embrace
element.description: You touch a willing creature and mark it with a tattoo of pure moonlight. Choose a lunar phase: Full Moon (see normally in darkness 60 ft.; advantage on Charisma checks and saves); Half Moon (AC can't be less than 16; Dodge as bonus action); Crescent Moon (illusory twin grants advantage on melee attacks; speed +15 ft.); New Moon (invisible as a bonus action until end of next turn; immune to emotion-reading/thought-reading).

element.name: Mist of the Moon Twins
element.description: You manifest a cloud of swirling silver fog in a 30-ft. radius. Choose up to eight creatures. While standing in the mist, they can see through it; the first time they enter on their turn and whenever they start their turn there, they gain temporary HP equal to 3d8 + your spellcasting modifier; when an attack targets them, roll d100—on 60 or less, the attack automatically misses. Other creatures are heavily obscured by the mist, which cannot be dispersed by wind.

element.name: Molten Shell

setters.set: V, S, M (a shard of obsidian)

element.description: A protective layer of molten volcanic rock covers you. You gain resistance to fire damage and 10 temporary hit points for the duration. If a creature hits you with a melee attack while you have these hit points, it takes 10 fire damage. Once the temp HP are lost, the rock hardens into an obsidian shell; the next time you're hit by a bludgeoning/piercing/slashing weapon attack, you take only half damage, then the shell breaks. At Higher Levels: +5 temp HP and +5 fire damage per slot level above 2nd.

element.name: Ride Lightning
element.description: Choose a point you can see within range. You summon a bolt of lightning and ride it there. Every creature in your path makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d10 lightning damage on a failure (half on success). The path is the shortest possible; movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. At Higher Levels: +1d10 damage per slot level above 4th.

element.name: Shape Light

setters.set: V, S, M (a visible light source and a shard of clear crystal)

element.description: Choose a manifestation: Moonlight (one nonmagical weapon becomes magical, +1d8 radiant damage, wielder gains 3/4 cover); Starlight (wall of 5 panels of shimmering starlight; one side imposes −1d4 on ranged attacks from it; creatures entering/starting in the wall make a Con save, 2d8 radiant damage on failure, half on success); Sunlight (5-ft. sphere of brilliant sunlight sheds bright light 15 ft. and dim light 30 ft. more; creatures starting within 15 ft. make a Con save, 3d8 radiant damage and blinded until start of next turn on failure, half damage and not blinded on success). At Higher Levels: +1d8 damage per slot level above 3rd.

element.name: Spirit Dart
element.description: You call a local nature spirit to your aid, creating an elemental dart. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 damage. The damage type depends on the spirit (1d6: Lava=Fire, Water=Cold, Wind=Thunder, Rock=Force, Vine=Poison, Storm=Lightning). The spell creates more darts at higher levels: two at 5th, three at 11th, four at 17th. Each dart can have a different damage type; make a separate attack roll for each.

element.name: Tropical Paradise

setters.set: V, M (a seed or pit of a tropical fruit)

element.description: A small magical grove of tropical fruit trees sprouts in a 15-ft. radius around you. Up to ten creatures you choose can rest and relax within. The atmosphere is warm and dry regardless of weather. Spells and magical effects can't extend into the grove unless you allow them, and other creatures can't enter. Creatures eating from the grove become immune to poison, their HP maximum increases by 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier, and they gain that many hit points. These benefits last for 24 hours.

element.name: Viper's Eyes

setters.set: S, M (the eye of a snake)
Bard, Druid, Ranger, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard

element.description: You touch a willing creature to grant it heat-signature vision: blindsight out to 60 ft. for the duration. However, when the creature takes fire or radiant damage, it must make a Constitution save (DC 10 or half the damage, whichever is higher). On a failure, it is disoriented and the spell ends early.

element.name: Volcanic Wall

setters.set: V, S, M (a handful of basalt)

element.description: You create a wall of lava on a solid surface within range: 6 inches thick, composed of ten 10-ft. by 10-ft. panels (each contiguous with at least one other). When it appears, creatures in its area make a Dexterity save, taking 6d6 fire damage and being knocked prone on a failure (half damage and not prone on success). One side (your choice) deals 6d6 fire damage to creatures ending their turn within 10 ft. of it or inside the wall; the same damage applies when a creature enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The other side is cooled igneous rock; each panel has AC 15 and 30 HP per inch of thickness. If you maintain concentration for the full duration, the wall cools into permanent stone (can't be dispelled). At Higher Levels: +1d6 damage per slot level above 5th.

element.name: Wrath of Lalahon

setters.set: V, S, M (500 gp worth of gold and obsidian dust, consumed)

element.description: Your flesh transforms into molten rock haloed in flame. For the duration: you gain temporary HP equal to 10 × your spellcasting modifier; you become immune to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder damage; at the start of your turn, creatures within 30 ft. must make a Constitution save or take 8d6 fire damage (you can designate up to ten creatures to be unaffected); you automatically succeed on concentration checks to maintain spells that deal fire or radiant damage.
